Polymath | Founding MTS, Full-Stack | San Francisco | ONSITE (5 days) | $160K–$220K + 0.75%–1.5% equity | https://polymathmade.com

Polymath builds AI agents that read engineering drawings, generate CAD models, and rebuild parts across CAD systems. We're VC-backed, Harvard- and Stanford-founded, in production with our first product, and running pilots with Fortune 100 manufacturers in aerospace and consumer hardware.

We're hiring our first dedicated full-stack engineer to own the product stack end to end: the chat UIs inside CAD (TypeScript/React over MCP and REST), the Python/FastAPI services behind them (auth, job orchestration, metered billing with Auth0 and Stripe), and the pipeline that packages and deploys it all. You report to the CEO, join customer calls, and set the standards for the next ten hires.

Looking for: 5+ years running production web apps with ownership across front end, API, and deployment; prior early-stage experience (first 50 engineers somewhere); TypeScript and Python; shipped on AWS or GCP with Terraform/CloudFormation and Kubernetes/ECS/Cloud Run. Nice to have: LLM product ops, enterprise SSO, C#/C++ desktop packaging, any CAD or mech-eng curiosity.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. Immediate start.

Apply: email jobs@example.com with a resume, a GitHub or portfolio link if you have one, and a few sentences on a system you built and ran in production. I read every application and reply within a week. Full JD: https://polymath-ai.notion.site/careers-1

OpenTrain AI | REMOTE (US) | Part-time | Backend Engineer, AI Coding Task Design

OpenTrain AI connects experienced professionals with paid, part-time AI training work. We are the hiring company and are actively filling this role.

- $30–$100 per hour equivalent, paid per accepted task - 100% remote, United States - About 15 hours/week; choose your schedule

We need backend engineers to design realistic coding tasks for AI systems, write deterministic verifiers, assess correctness and code quality, and apply secure coding and security review where relevant. This work helps improve AI systems that write software.

Ideal background - Strong professional backend experience with Python, Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, TypeScript, C++ or similar - Scalable APIs/services, complex features, debugging, bottleneck resolution and code review - Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical communication skills; professional English - Helpful: application security, secure coding, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, OWASP/CWE or security-focused code review - No AI experience needed; structured task-design guidelines and verification criteria are provided

Independent contractor; pay is per accepted task. Fully remote and flexible, with no fixed shifts. Apply on OpenTrain (resume upload): https://app.opentrain.ai/api/out/cmu9linxg000o0bgm9xiw33b9?c...

Then complete a short application on the hiring platform. Shortlisted applicants take a short AI interview.

Nirvana Robotics | Mechanical Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Robotic Controls Engineer | New York, NY | ONSITE | Full-time | $220K-$300K

Nirvana Robotics builds humanoid robots with robotic arms that work in industrial environments. Their hardware team in NYC is growing, and each of these roles owns a subsystem end to end on physical robots. I'm a recruiter at Niuro, Nirvana's hiring partner for these roles; the links below go to our application form and I read every application myself.

Mechanical Engineer ($230K-$260K): mechanical design of robotic arms and manipulators: joints, actuators, transmissions, end effectors. You optimize for torque density, backdrivability and stiffness, prototype with additive and precision machining, and take assemblies to production. GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, SolidWorks (or Creo/NX/Onshape). Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/H4yYHesP?ref=ps_EBRp88zU7jcdRZm8...

Electrical Engineer ($220K-$250K): electrical architecture for arms and humanoids: power distribution, motor-driver boards, sensor PCBs, harnessing. Multilayer mixed-signal and high-current layout in Altium, BLDC drivers and current sensing, bench bring-up and DFM with PCBA partners. EtherCAT, CAN or BMS is a plus. Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/BeVx3CrN?ref=ps_5biniQ0FTotNxfmT...

Robotic Controls Engineer ($270K-$300K): low-level control for multi-DOF arms: joint-level actuation, impedance/admittance and whole-body control, sim-to-real. PID/LQR/state-space, MoveIt or cuRobo, C++ and Python, ROS 2. Apply: https://app.niuro.io/source/gUNqx8Lj?ref=ps_BdIAhZPrP7yQt2P4...

For all three: hands-on work on real robot hardware (arms, grippers, mobile manipulators, actuated joints or humanoids). Mechanical and Electrical: 5+ years with a bachelor's or 3+ with a master's. Controls: roughly BS + 4 years, MS + 2 or a PhD. US-based; relocation to NYC within the US is supported. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Flow Traders | Research Engineer | Hong Kong | Full Time | Visa | Relocation Flow Traders is a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative Tech culture at the heart of its business. We are looking for Research Engineers in our Hong Kong office. Join us build and scale the research framework behind our systematic trading models. You’ll work closely with Quantitative Researchers, drive end‑to‑end ML pipelines, and shape global standards for data‑driven model development. Research Engineers have joint responsibility for conducting research and delivering models. You’ll thrive if you have: - 8+ years in ML / Data Science / Research Engineering (Postdoc/Faculty can count towards this); - Strong Python and libraries such as Ray, numpy, PyTorch, and pandas; - Solid math/stats background; - Experience with modern dev practices & cloud technologies. If you're interested, apply here: https://www.flowtraders.com/careers/job-description/7431246

Flow Traders | C++ Senior Software Engineer | Hong Kong | Full Time | Visa | Relocation We are looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer, you'll help design and optimize next-generation market data and execution platforms powering systematic trading across hundreds of venues. The role covers high performance market data ingestion and order execution, building and optimizing trading systems. To succeed you will need to have: - 5+ years of C++ experience in HFT/ financial sector -Strong knowledge in one or more APAC markets If you are interested, apply here: https://www.flowtraders.com/careers/job-description/8212740

Or if you'd like to see other roles at Flow Traders, please check our careers website: https://flowtraders.com/careers/
